notes:
Big update. Everything from the 1.3.x testing builds in one go.

- New Monsters tab: a guide for every large monster. Where to hit, best element and statuses, what it attacks with, what items work, full hitzones and drops
- Best builds against a monster: pick a weapon type and it finds the builds that hit that monster hardest, with resistance to its attacks
- New Hunts tab: every large monster you fight is logged with time, result and weapon. Personal bests per monster
- Damage tab in Builds: compare your builds' damage per hit on every part of a monster
- Hunted monsters: mark what you've hunted (normal, tempered, arch-tempered) and the calculator only uses gear you can craft
- Calculator: results look like the in-game skill list, "Use γ armor" option, clear build button
- Search ignores apostrophes and understands γ / gamma / y and III / 3
- Works in small windows: tabs scroll, layouts stack
- Data reader v7 (update it from the Updates tab): records your hunts
